categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Optimizes `CBlockIndexWorkComparator` used for block index candidate ordering and validation operations in `src/node/blockstorage.h`.
categories.rationale: Micro-optimizes block index candidate comparisons, yielding measured 6.5x comparator throughput gains and 1.4x–1.6x faster `CheckBlockIndex`. While it measurably optimizes a hot path in chainstate work comparisons, it is a localized micro-optimization rather than a major end-to-end IBD or block connection performance improvement.
